import json,subprocess,os,stat,datetime
from pathlib import Path
print('AUDIT_UTC',datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat())
def run(args,t=20):
 try:
  p=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=t)
  return p.returncode,p.stdout.strip()
 except Exception as e:return -1,type(e).__name__
def du(x,t=35):
 rc,out=run(['du','-x','-s','-B1',str(x)],t)
 return out.split()[0] if rc==0 and out else 'UNKNOWN'
root=Path('/srv/projects')
print('===CANONICAL_PROJECTS===')
if not root.is_dir() or root.is_symlink():raise RuntimeError('Missing canonical projects root')
for item in sorted(root.iterdir()):
 if item.is_dir() and not item.is_symlink():
  print('PROJECT',item.name,'BYTES',du(item,50),'UID',item.stat().st_uid,'GID',item.stat().st_gid)
 else: print('OTHER',item.name,'SYMLINK',item.is_symlink())
print('===COMPAT_LINKS===')
for name,p in [
 ('telegram-robot-leads','/opt/telegram-robot-leads'),
 ('iptvpn-bot','/root/iptvpn_bot'),('pink-iptv','/srv/pink-iptv'),
 ('lowcost-europa','/srv/lowcost-europa'),('fadego','/srv/fadego-staging'),
 ('skill-universal','/home/ubuntu/.local/share/motor-ferrari'),
 ('Engenheira-reversa','/home/ubuntu/.local/share/rea-chatgpt-trial')]:
 q=Path(p)
 print('COMPAT',name,'IS_LINK',q.is_symlink(),'TARGET',str(q.resolve()) if q.is_symlink() else '-')
print('===PM2_METADATA_NO_SECRETS===')
rc,t=run(['pm2','jlist'],25)
if rc!=0: raise RuntimeError('PM2 unavailable')
for a in json.loads(t):
 if a.get('name') not in ('telegram-robot-leads','iptvpn_bot'):continue
 e=a.get('pm2_env') or {}
 print('PM2',a.get('name'),'STATUS',e.get('status'),'PID',a.get('pid'),'CWD',e.get('pm_cwd'),'SCRIPT',e.get('pm_exec_path'),'INTERPRETER',e.get('exec_interpreter'))
 for k in ['TELEGRAM_OPERATION_STATE','TELEGRAM_EVENT_JOURNAL','TELEGRAM_SESSION_FILE','TELEGRAM_SESSIONS_DIR','TELEGRAM_VAULT_DIR','TELEGRAM_PRIVATE_DIR']:
  if k in e:
   v=e[k]
   print('PM2_PATH_KEY',a.get('name'),k,'PRESENT','CANONICAL' if str(v).startswith('/srv/projects/') else 'EXTERNAL' if str(v).startswith('/') else 'RELATIVE')
print('===PRIVATE_OWNERSHIP_METADATA===')
for tag,p in [
 ('telegram-leads-vault','/root/project-secrets/telegram-robot-leads'),
 ('telegram-leads-state','/var/lib/telegram-robot-leads'),
 ('leads-canonical-vault','/srv/projects/telegram-robot-leads/private'),
 ('leads-canonical-data','/srv/projects/telegram-robot-leads/data'),
 ('iptvpn-private','/root/project-secrets/iptvpn_bot'),
 ('iptvpn-etc','/etc/iptvpn-bot')]:
 path=Path(p)
 if path.exists() or path.is_symlink():
  s=path.lstat()
  print('PRIVATE',tag,'KIND','SYMLINK' if path.is_symlink() else 'DIR' if path.is_dir() else 'FILE','MODE',oct(s.st_mode&0o777),'OWNER',s.st_uid,'BYTES',du(path) if path.is_dir() and not path.is_symlink() else '-')
  if tag=='telegram-leads-vault' and path.is_dir():
   print('SESSION_FILES_COUNT',sum(1 for x in path.rglob('*.session') if x.is_file()))
 else:print('PRIVATE',tag,'ABSENT')
print('===RUNTIME_PATH_REFERENCES===')
for repo,paths in [
 ('telegram-robot-leads',['ecosystem.config.js','main.py','scripts/activate_project_only.py','scripts/deploy_project_only.py','scripts/telethon_sessions.py','scripts/safe_runtime.py']),
 ('iptvpn-bot',['ecosystem.config.js','start.sh','main.py'])]:
 base=root/repo
 for name in paths:
  p=base/name
  if not p.is_file():continue
  data=p.read_text(errors='replace')
  for old in ['/var/lib/telegram-robot-leads','/root/project-secrets/telegram-robot-leads','/opt/telegram-robot-leads','/root/iptvpn_bot','/etc/iptvpn-bot']:
   n=data.count(old)
   if n: print('PATHREF',repo,name,old,'COUNT',n)
print('===SYSTEMD===')
for s in ['fadego-staging','lowcost-europa','pink-iptv-backend','pink-vpn','pm2-root','postgresql@16-main','nginx','ssh']:
 rc,t=run(['systemctl','show',s+'.service','--no-pager','-p','ActiveState','-p','MainPID','-p','WorkingDirectory'],10)
 print('SERVICE',s,t.replace('\n','|') if rc==0 else 'QUERY_FAILED')

for name,p in [
 ('rea-final','/home/ubuntu/rea-final-runtime'),('rea-upstream','/home/ubuntu/rea-original-upstream-680'),
 ('rea-evidence','/home/ubuntu/rea-original-upstream-680-evidence'),
 ('codex-agent','/home/ubuntu/codex-agent'),('codex-bridge','/home/ubuntu/codex-bridge'),

 print('OUTSIDE',name,'PATH',p,'TYPE','SYMLINK' if x.is_symlink() else 'DIR' if x.is_dir() else 'ABSENT','SIZE',du(x) if x.is_dir() and not x.is_symlink() else '-')
